## Invitations

During the first quarter outreach activity in North City, 6667 people were invited to attend. A total of 4522 people attended, representing an attendance rate of 67.8 per cent. This indicates that attendance was higher than the number of people who did not attend, although further follow-up may be appropriate where engagement was not achieved.

Van days were maintained where road conditions allowed. This supported continued outreach activity and helped provide access in areas where travel conditions permitted.

## Contact

No invitations were sent by SMS. The SMS total was 0. No reminder messages were issued, and the number of people receiving a reminder was 0. Contact arrangements therefore relied on the invitation process and available van-day activity rather than text-message reminders.

The report was prepared by G. Evans.
